title: Fixing the reference time so that age does not change during a test

timeline.message:
Fixing the reference time so that age does not change during a test

This change makes it so that the reference time from which the "age" field of the IndexLifecycleExplainResponse
object is derived does not change for the duration of testConcurrentToXContent().
timeline.author: Keith Massey

timeline.body:
This is a backport of #84528

This change makes it so that the reference time from which the "age" field of the IndexLifecycleExplainResponse object is derived does not change for the duration of testConcurrentToXContent().

Fixes #116222
Relates #84352

timeline.author: Niels Bauman

timeline.body: Just as an aside, I think it would be best practice to use `LongSupplier` here. Since this is a backport, I think it's best to stick with what you have — it obviously doesn't deserve either introducing a diff between `8.x` and `main`, or doing an extra PR on `main`. So just consider this me flying the flag for this under-loved family of interfaces!
